arxiv-2011-11877.title: InstaHide’s Sample Complexity When Mixing Two Private Images
arxiv-2011-11877.creator: Baihe Huang, Zhao Song, Runzhou Tao, Junze Yin, Ruizhe Zhang, Danyang Zhuo
arxiv-2011-11877.description: Abstract Training neural networks usually require large numbers of sensitive training data, and how to protect the privacy of training data has thus become a critical topic in deep learning research. InstaHide is a state-of-the-art scheme to protect training data privacy with only minor effects on test accuracy, and its security has become a salient question.

arxiv-2012-12516.title: Analyzing Representations inside Convolutional Neural Networks
arxiv-2012-12516.creator: Uday Singh Saini, Evangelos E. Papalexakis
arxiv-2012-12516.description: Abstract How can we discover and succinctly summarize the concepts that a neural network has learned? Such a task is of great importance in applications of networks in areas of inference that involve classification, like medical diagnosis based on fMRI/x-ray etc.

arxiv-2201-00939.title: Neutrino bound states and bound systems
arxiv-2201-00939.creator: Alexei Yu. Smirnov a and Xun-Jie Xu b
arxiv-2201-00939.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Alexei Yu. Smirnov a and Xun-Jie Xu b. Yukawa interactions of neutrinos with a new light scalar boson ϕ \phi can lead to formation of stable bound states and bound systems of many neutrinos ( ν \nu -clusters). For allowed values of the coupling y y and the scalar mass m ϕ m_{\phi} , the bound state of two neutrinos would have the size larger than 10 12 10^{12} cm.

arxiv-2204-06370.title: A model grid for the reflected light from transition disks
arxiv-2204-06370.creator: J. Ma, H.M. Schmid ,
arxiv-2204-06370.description: Abstract Context. The dust in protoplanetary disks is an important ingredient in planet formation and can be investigated with model simulations and quantitative imaging polarimetry of the scattered stellar light. Aims. This study explores circumstellar disks with calculations for the intensity and polarization of the reflected light.

arxiv-2312-15019.title: The uniform existence time and Zero-Alpha limit problem of the Euler-Poincaré equations
arxiv-2312-15019.creator: Min Li, Zhaoyang Yin
arxiv-2312-15019.description: Abstract Abstract: We consider the Cauchy problem of the Euler-Poincaré equations in \mathbb{R}^{d} with a varying dispersion parameter \alpha . Based on the convex entropy structure and the modified commutator estimates, we have proved that the Euler-Poincaré equations have a uniform existence time with respect to \alpha in Sobolev spaces H^{s}.

arxiv-2510-12069.title: VidMP3 : Video Editing by Representing Motion with Pose and Position Priors
arxiv-2510-12069.creator: Sandeep Mishra, Oindrila Saha, Alan C. Bovik
arxiv-2510-12069.description: Abstract Motion-preserved video editing is crucial for creators, particularly in scenarios that demand flexibility in both the structure and semantics of swapped objects. Despite its potential, this area remains underexplored. Existing diffusion-based editing methods excel in structure-preserving tasks, using dense guidance signals to ensure content integrity.

arxiv-2511-17456.title: Fermat near misses and the integral Hilbert property
arxiv-2511-17456.creator: Jessica Alessandrì, Daniel Loughran
arxiv-2511-17456.description: Abstract . We consider the Diophantine equation x 4 + y 4 − w 2 = n x^{4}+y^{4}-w^{2}=n for n ∈ ℤ n\in{\mathbb{Z}} , which is related to near misses for the quartic case of Fermat’s Last Theorem. For certain n n we show that the set of solutions is infinite, or more generally not thin .

pmc-10571980.title: The Effect of Maternal Probiotic or Synbiotic Supplementation on Sow and Offspring Gastrointestinal Microbiota, Health, and Performance
pmc-10571980.creator: Dillon P Kiernan, John V O’Doherty, Torres Sweeney, Hyeun Bum Kim
pmc-10571980.description: Simple SummaryThe gastrointestinal tract (GIT) microbiota refers to the collection of microorganisms that colonize the GIT. The composition and diversity of the GIT microbiota play a fundamental role in animal health and performance and is an area that is becoming increasingly important with recent introduction of new restrictions on antibiotic and antimicrobial use in animal production.

pmc-10645609.title: Novel Metschnikowia yeasts from the gut of green lacewing in Japan
pmc-10645609.creator: Yuma Yoshihashi, Yousuke Degawa
pmc-10645609.description: Family Chrysopidae is known to harbor specific gut yeasts. However, no studies have been conducted outside of a limited number of these green lacewing species, and the diversity of yeasts in the family as a whole is not known. Therefore, we collected 58 Chrysopidae adults (9 species, 6 genera, 2 subfamilies) in Japan and isolated yeasts from all individuals.

pmc-12468932.title: Drug Repurposing for Targeting Cancer Stem-like Cells in Glioblastoma
pmc-12468932.creator: Ana Luísa De Sousa-Coelho, Brigita Solaković, Alexandra Diogo Bento, Mónica Teotónio Fernandes, Yonehiro Kanemura
pmc-12468932.description: Simple SummaryGlioblastoma is one of the deadliest cancers, with most patients living only a short time after diagnosis due to treatment resistance and recurrence. A key driver of resistance is a subpopulation of tumor cells called glioblastoma stem-like cells (GSCs), which assist the tumor in resisting therapies and regrowth.

pmc-12499572.title: Efficacy and Safety of Different Sequences for mFOLFIRINOX (or SOXIRI) and Gemcitabine Plus Albumin-Bound Paclitaxel in Unresectable Pancreatic Cancer
pmc-12499572.creator: Silan Huang, Lingli Huang, Dongsheng Zhang, Qi Jiang, Fenghua Wang, Guifang Guo
pmc-12499572.description: AimThis study aimed to evaluate and compare the therapeutic efficacy and adverse effects of two sequential treatment strategies in patients with unresectable advanced pancreatic cancer (aPC), albumin-bound-paclitaxel plus gemcitabine administered follow by mFOLFIRINOX or SOXIRI (AG-F(S)FXm) versus the reverse sequence regimen F(S)FXm-AG.MethodsIn this retrospective analysis, patients with unresectable advanced pancreatic cancer (aPC) who received either AG-F(S)FXm or F(S)FXm-AG were included.

pmc-12649148.title: The Efficacy of Fisheries Management: A Length-Based Stock Assessment of Eight Fish Species in Xingkai Lake, China
pmc-12649148.creator: Chen Zhao, Zhongsi Gao, Xuehao Wang, Wanting Wang, Huibo Wang, Le Wang, Tangbin Huo, Øivind Bergh
pmc-12649148.description: Simple SummaryOverfishing has led to a continuous decline in fishery resources in Xingkai Lake, the largest transboundary freshwater lake in Asia, though the specific status of fish populations has lacked scientific assessment. To promote resource recovery, local authorities implemented a large-mesh fishing gear policy in 2019, yet its effectiveness remained unclear.

pmc-12714501.title: Autonomic Dysfunction and Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome Secondary to Abuse
pmc-12714501.creator: Samuel Reiss, Rachel Reiss, Craig Reiss
pmc-12714501.description: Postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome (POTS) and other forms of autonomic dysfunction are increasingly recognized in patients with histories of physical or psychological trauma. Emerging evidence suggests that trauma-related dysregulation of the autonomic nervous system may manifest as POTS, with hypervigilance and hyperadrenergic states proposed as potential mechanisms. However, the relationship between sexual abuse and subsequent autonomic dysfunction remains unclear.

pmc-13300677.title: Laryngeal mask airway versus endotracheal intubation for airway management during pulsed field ablation of atrial fibrillation: a multicenter observational study
pmc-13300677.creator: L D'angelo, S Bianchi, C Tondo, F Solimene, M Bertini, S Iacopino, A Rossillo, S Themistoclakis, M Casella, A Bisignani, M Schiavone, V Schillaci, A Di Cori, M Malacrida, A Dello Russo
pmc-13300677.description: BackgroundEndotracheal intubation (ETI) is the standard airway management technique during general anesthesia for atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation. The laryngeal mask airway (LMA) may offer advantages such as easier placement and reduced hemodynamic stress, but data on its feasibility, safety, and patient experience during pulsed field ablation (PFA) are limited.
